learning_outcomes_owner_check.name: learning_outcomes_owner_check
learning_outcomes_owner_check.value: ("learning_outcomes"."level" = 'program' AND "learning_outcomes"."program_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_outcomes"."course_id" IS NULL) OR ("learning_outcomes"."level" = 'course' AND "learning_outcomes"."course_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_outcomes"."program_id" IS NULL)

user_roles_scope_check.name: user_roles_scope_check
user_roles_scope_check.value: ("user_roles"."scope_type" = 'platform' AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NULL AND "user_roles"."institution_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_roles"."scope_type" = 'group' AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_roles"."institution_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_roles"."scope_type" IN ('institution', 'campus') AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_roles"."institution_id" IS NOT NULL)
